test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Fortunately, he passed the exams/ with dint of/ sheer hard work and diligence.
solution:
The solution is** with dint of. **

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part that contains the error from "**Fortunately, he passed the exams/ with dint of/ sheer hard work and diligence**." is with dint of. 
 
• The correct sentence is "*** Fortunately, he passed the exams by__ dint of sheer hard work and diligence. ***"
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Here **by **is a preposition or an adverb.
 
• Preposition__: *Preposition is a word which shows position of an object.
 __
 
• *For example : "They sat on dinning table for the dinner." , "The flowers are inside the vase." , "He left at 8'oclock."*
 
 
 
• *​****Adverb__: ***A word or a phrase that modifies an adjective, verb or a group of words expressing relation of time, place, manner, etc.
 
 
• *For example *: *"What time is he coming home?", "This is the town where I grew up."*
